scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --raw -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,magenta" --hide "CLIENT" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.lint: concurrently "npm run lint -w server" "npm run lint -w client" "npm run lint -w shared"
scripts.format: concurrently "npm run format -w server" "npm run format -w client" "npm run format -w shared"
